data.reasoning: Deepseek successfully reviewed all package files, including the PKGBUILD and the launcher script, finding them to be standard and free of malicious code. data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by an API failure (HTTP 400) in the Qwen model, which prevented it from reviewing the PKGBUILD and launcher script, resulting in an inconclusive verdict. Deepseek successfully reviewed all files and found no issues.
coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to review PKGBUILD and altair-ai-studio.sh due to LLM API HTTP 400 errors.
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback models when an LLM API request fails with a 4xx/5xx error to prevent inconclusive verdicts due to transient API issues.
Ensure that tool errors are clearly distinguished from actual security inconclusiveness in the final verdict aggregation.
